description: Context-sensitive scenarios for the opt-in live LLM acceptance gate. Each scenario names only the operator request, the starting harness steps that put the real coordinator into the scenario's starting state, and the expected ordered tool-name sequence a correct policy produces. Context (event_context, evidence_context, legal_tools, argument values) is never hand-authored here: it comes from the real AgentLoop reading the real repository through DecisionState/legal_set, so no identifier is smuggled into this fixture (see P1 defect D10). tests/agent/test_live_gate_real_loop.py drives these scenarios through the real coordinator gateway.

scenarios.name: initial_plan_one_station
scenarios.user_request: Survey only the LEFT_ALLEY_MIDDLE station. Marker-verified plans are unavailable for this run, so exclude any plan that requires marker verification; among the remaining plans, propose the one with the fewest stations.

scenarios.name: qualifying_evidence_to_task
scenarios.user_request: A qualifying rock detection with accepted evidence is available. Create the remediation task for it, then rank and propose a patroller.

scenarios.name: approval_wait
scenarios.user_request: A plan proposal is awaiting operator confirmation. Do not propose anything new while approval is pending.
